question: Will Ethereum be above $1,875 on Binance at 7:59 PM EDT on August 13, 2026?

model.prompt_context: This market resolves based on the price of Ethereum in USDT on the Binance spot market (ETHUSDT). The reference price is the close price of the Binance ETHUSDT 1-minute kline with open time 23:58:00 UTC on August 13, 2026 (7:58:00 PM EDT) — the last fully completed 1-minute candle as of the 7:59 PM EDT observation time. Resolves to "Yes" if that close price is strictly greater than 1,875.00 USDT. Resolves to "No" if it is equal to or less than 1,875.00 USDT. If the Binance API reports no kline for that minute (e.g., exchange downtime), the reference price is the close of the nearest preceding completed ETHUSDT 1-minute kline.
